tests.name: Rig: Place Stardock in a free scan sector

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET sector_id = (SELECT MAX(s.sector_id) FROM sectors s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ports p WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND p.port_id <> 9 AND p.sector_id = s.sector_id)), is_active = TRUE WHERE port_id = 9;

tests.name: Rig: Place scan player and active ship at Stardock

data.sql: WITH moved_active_ship AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM ports WHERE port_id = 9) WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{scan_user_player_id})) UPDATE players SET sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM ports WHERE port_id = 9) WHERE player_id = @{scan_user_player_id};
